name: Template Climate
description: The `template` climate platform lets you create a fully-featured climate entity out of plain ESPHome primitives. It is useful for wrapping custom UART/I²C climate controllers, integrating hardware that lacks a dedicated ESPHome component, or prototyping climate integrations.

config_entries.label: Name
config_entries.description: The name of the climate device. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

config_entries.label: Icon
config_entries.description: Manually set the icon to use for the climate device in the frontend.

config_entries.label: Restore Mode
config_entries.description: Controls whether climate state (mode, target temperature, fan mode, swing mode, and preset) is persisted to flash and restored on reboot.

options.label: NO_RESTORE
options.description: Always start from the plain defaults (or initial_state:, if set) -- never restore.

config_entries.label: Humidity Sensor
config_entries.description: The ID of a [sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/) that provides the measured (ambient) relative humidity. Same push-based behavior as `sensor`, but for `current_humidity`.

config_entries.label: Sensor
config_entries.description: The ID of a [sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/) that provides the measured (ambient) temperature. The climate entity subscribes to the sensor and updates `current_temperature` whenever the sensor reports a new reading -- there is no polling. Also advertises the current-temperature feature. A sensor that becomes unavailable clears the value rather than leaving the last reading on display. If you need to feed in a reading that isn't backed by real hardware (e.g. parsed out of a UART response), publish it to a plain `platform: template` sensor with [`sensor.template.publish`](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/template/#sensor-template-publish-action) and point `sensor` at that.

config_entries.label: Supported Modes
config_entries.description: List of operating modes to expose to the frontend. Valid values: `OFF`, `HEAT`, `COOL`, `AUTO`, `HEAT_COOL`, `FAN_ONLY`, `DRY`. > [!NOTE] > `supported_modes` is evaluated at compile time. It cannot be changed at runtime.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID for code generation. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

config_entries.label: Action State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish climate device action changes to.

config_entries.label: Current Humidity State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish current humidity changes to.

config_entries.label: Current Temperature State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish current temperature changes to.

config_entries.label: Custom Fan Modes
config_entries.description: List of arbitrary fan mode names to expose to the frontend, for devices with proprietary fan modes not covered by `supported_fan_modes`.

config_entries.label: Custom Presets
config_entries.description: List of arbitrary preset names to expose to the frontend, for devices with proprietary presets not covered by `supported_presets`.

config_entries.label: Disabled By Default
config_entries.description: If true, then this entity should not be added to any client's frontend, (usually Home Assistant) without the user manually enabling it (via the Home Assistant UI). Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Entity Category
config_entries.description: The category of the entity. See [https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties) for a list of available options. Set to `""` to remove the default entity category.

config_entries.label: Fan Mode Command Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to receive fan mode commands on.

config_entries.label: Fan Mode State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish fan mode changes to.

config_entries.label: Initial State
config_entries.description: Sets a boot-time default for any of the settable properties, for use before anything has been restored (with `restore_mode: RESTORE`) or reported (with `climate.template.publish`). Accepts the same keys as [`climate.template.publish`](https://esphome.io/components/climate/template#climate-template-publish_action), except `current_temperature` / `current_humidity` / `action`, which are reported values rather than static defaults.

config_entries.label: Internal
config_entries.description: Mark this component as internal. Internal components will not be exposed to the frontend (like Home Assistant). Only specifying an `id` without a `name` will implicitly set this to true.

config_entries.label: Mode Command Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to receive climate device mode commands on.

config_entries.label: Mode State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish climate device mode changes to.

config_entries.label: Optimistic
config_entries.description: Controls whether a settable property (mode, target temperature, fan mode, swing mode, preset, etc.) updates immediately when a command is received (`true`, default) or only once `climate.template.publish` reports the device's actual state (`false`).

config_entries.label: Preset Command Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to receive preset commands on.

config_entries.label: Preset State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish preset changes to.

config_entries.label: Set Custom Fan Mode Action
config_entries.description: The action to perform when a custom fan mode is requested. The name is available as `x`, a `StringRef` -- use `x.c_str()` to pass it to a `%s` format.

config_entries.label: Set Custom Preset Action
config_entries.description: The action to perform when a custom preset is requested. Same `StringRef` handling as `set_custom_fan_mode_action`.

config_entries.label: Set Fan Mode Action
config_entries.description: The action to perform when a new fan mode is requested, available as `x`.

config_entries.label: Set Mode Action
config_entries.description: The action to perform when a new mode is requested. The requested mode is available as `x`.

config_entries.label: Set Preset Action
config_entries.description: The action to perform when a new preset is requested, available as `x`.

config_entries.label: Set Swing Mode Action
config_entries.description: The action to perform when a new swing mode is requested, available as `x`.

config_entries.label: Set Target Humidity Action
config_entries.description: The action to perform when a new target humidity is requested, available as `x`. Configuring it advertises `supports_target_humidity`.

config_entries.label: Set Target Temperature Action
config_entries.description: The action to perform when a new target temperature is requested, available as `x`. Cannot be used together with the two-point actions below.

config_entries.label: Set Target Temperature High Action
config_entries.description: The action to perform when a new upper bound of the target temperature range is requested, available as `x`. Must be used together with `set_target_temperature_low_action`.

config_entries.label: Set Target Temperature Low Action
config_entries.description: The action to perform when a new lower bound of the target temperature range is requested, available as `x`. Must be used together with `set_target_temperature_high_action`. Configuring it advertises `supports_two_point_target_temperature`.

config_entries.label: Supported Fan Modes
config_entries.description: List of fan modes to expose to the frontend. Valid values: `ON`, `OFF`, `AUTO`, `LOW`, `MEDIUM`, `HIGH`, `MIDDLE`, `FOCUS`, `DIFFUSE`, `QUIET`.

config_entries.label: Supported Presets
config_entries.description: List of presets to expose to the frontend. Valid values: `NONE`, `ECO`, `AWAY`, `BOOST`, `COMFORT`, `HOME`, `SLEEP`, `ACTIVITY`.

config_entries.label: Supported Swing Modes
config_entries.description: List of swing modes to expose to the frontend. Valid values: `OFF`, `BOTH`, `VERTICAL`, `HORIZONTAL`.

config_entries.label: Supports Action
config_entries.description: Whether to advertise the current climate action (`IDLE`, `HEATING`, `COOLING`, etc.) trait. `action` has no sensor of its own -- report it with `climate.template.publish`. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Supports Current Humidity
config_entries.description: Same as `supports_current_temperature`, but for the current-humidity trait / `humidity_sensor`.

config_entries.label: Supports Current Temperature
config_entries.description: Whether to advertise the current-temperature trait. You normally don't need to set this: it is enabled automatically when `sensor` is configured. Set it to `true` on its own to advertise the trait without a sensor, for reporting the value yourself via `climate.template.publish`. Setting it to `false` while `sensor` is configured is a configuration error.

config_entries.label: Supports Target Humidity
config_entries.description: Whether to advertise a settable `target_humidity`. Enabled automatically when `set_target_humidity_action` is configured, and follows the same rules as `supports_two_point_target_temperature` otherwise.

config_entries.label: Supports Two Point Target Temperature
config_entries.description: Whether to advertise `target_temperature_low` / `target_temperature_high` (used for `HEAT_COOL` mode) instead of a single `target_temperature`. Enabled automatically when `set_target_temperature_low_action` / `set_target_temperature_high_action` are configured. Set it to `true` on its own to advertise the trait without those actions; setting it to `false` while either is configured is a configuration error.

config_entries.label: Swing Mode Command Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to receive swing mode commands on.

config_entries.label: Swing Mode State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish swing mode changes to.

config_entries.label: Target Humidity Command Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to receive target humidity commands on.

config_entries.label: Target Humidity State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish target humidity changes to.

config_entries.label: Target Temperature Command Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to receive target temperature commands on.

config_entries.label: Target Temperature High Command Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to receive higher target temperature commands on.

config_entries.label: Target Temperature High State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish higher target temperature changes to.

config_entries.label: Target Temperature Low Command Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to receive lower target temperature commands on.

config_entries.label: Target Temperature Low State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish lower target temperature changes to.

config_entries.label: Target Temperature State Topic
config_entries.description: The topic to publish target temperature changes to.

config_entries.label: Visual
config_entries.description: Visual settings for the climate device - these do not affect operation and are solely for controlling how the climate device shows up in the frontend.

config_entries.label: Max Humidity
config_entries.description: The maximum humidity the climate device can reach. Used to set the range of the frontend gauge.

config_entries.label: Max Temperature
config_entries.description: The maximum temperature the climate device can reach. Used to set the range of the frontend gauge.

config_entries.label: Min Humidity
config_entries.description: The minimum humidity the climate device can reach. Used to set the range of the frontend gauge.

config_entries.label: Min Temperature
config_entries.description: The minimum temperature the climate device can reach. Used to set the range of the frontend gauge.

config_entries.label: Temperature Step
config_entries.description: The granularity with which the target temperature can be controlled.
